tools.name: find_places
tools.description: Look up places by name and get their ids. Searches the 85 cities and regions with full reports, the ~13,000 towns being verified and ~475,000 villages and towns in Europe. Use the id with get_place or compare_places.

tools.name: rank_places
tools.description: Rank places for someone's priorities, the way where-tomorrow.com ranks them. Each priority is 0 (does not matter) to 4 (matters most); leaving them all out ranks on the plain average. tools.name: get_place
tools.description: Every figure we hold for one place: its eight scores today and for 2035, its cost, winter, walkability, weather and taxes, and for a city or region with a report its detailed figures (rent, wages, life expectancy and more), each with its source and date. Get the id from find_places or rank_places.

tools.name: compare_places
tools.description: Two to four places side by side: their eight scores and their card figures, each with its source and date, a link to each place and a chart image. Get ids from find_places or rank_places.
